topic: Treat the README as part of the interview
angle: For AI engineer take-homes and portfolio projects, a polished README can matter as much as the code because reviewers may only have a few minutes.
cta: Watch the recording and workshop materials.

source_moments.note: The README should explain storyline, decisions, limitations, generated code, and follow-up work.
Hiring managers may start with the README; include tests, evals, monitoring, screenshots, and next steps.
